mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and stimulates risk-taking, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases the discount rate for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals a strengthening real economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 10%, it signals a severe recession that increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low industrial production index (below 95) signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.

mechanism_narrative: A negative year-over-year growth rate in GDP (GDPC1) signals an ongoing recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 YoY growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of inflation above 2% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL) and a federal funds rate below 0.5% signals a stable inflation environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.
